responses_to_directives.description: One entry per AC camera_ready_directives item. The Professor must address every directive — explicitly accepting, partially accepting with rationale, or escalating back to AC with reasons. No silent skipping.

professor_reply.description: Professor's natural-language reply to the AC directive — what was added/changed and why.

scope_statement.description: Revised scope statement reflecting load-bearing objections that survived rebuttal. Plain prose. Anchors the camera-ready paper's claim under test.

mental_model_statement.description: The single good mental model this research gives the reader. Required field — a paper without one is a list of results, not a paper. Plain prose, 2-4 sentences, operator language.

limitations_added.description: Limitations section additions sourced from rebuttal_synthesis.minority_dissent + load_bearing_objections.

advisor_acknowledgement.description: Professor's reply to the AC's advisor_message_to_professor. Acknowledges what was internalized.
